g.text: Number and mass particle-size distributions weight the same population differently

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Number PDF and cumulative use one lognormal population; mass PDF shifts its log-mean by3σ² through d³ weighting. PDFs integrate to1 over positive size and
have inverse-size units; CDFs are dimensionless. Display window truncates a small upper tail. Mass equals volume weighting only for equal particle
